coastland_times.headline: NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
coastland_times.body: NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE NORTH CAROLINA, DARE COUNTY Under and by virtue of a Power of Sale contained in that certain Deed of Trust executed by William R. Bohon, Sr. and Donna J. Bohon to Trste, Inc., Trustee(s), which was dated June 29, 2007 and recorded on July 26, 2007 in Book 1738 at Page 37, Dare County Registry, North Carolina. Default having been made of the note thereby secured by the said Deed of Trust and the undersigned, Trustee Services of Carolina, LLC, having been substituted as Trustee in said Deed of Trust, and the holder of the note evidencing said default having directed that the Deed of Trust be foreclosed, the undersigned Substitute Trustee will offer for sale at the courthouse door of the county courthouse where the property is located, or the usual and customary location at the county courthouse for conducting the sale on December 1, 2026 at 11:30 AM, and will sell to the highest bidder for cash the following described property situated in Dare County, North Carolina, to wit: THE FOLLOWING REAL PROPERTY SITUATE IN COUNTY OF DARE AND STATE OF NORTH CAROLINA, DESCRIBED AS FOLLOWS: BEING THAT CERTAIN PARCEL OR UNIT OF LAND WITH IMPROVEMENTS THEREON, BEING UNIT 101, OF GULF STREAM CONDOMINIUMS, A CONDOMINIUM CREATED PURSUANT TO THE UNIT OWNERSHIP ACT OF NORTH CAROLINA ACCORDING TO A DECLARATION OF UNIT OWNERSHIP RECORDED IN BOOK 526, PAGE 25, IN THE CONDOMINIUM PLAT BOOK 3, UNIT OWNERSHIP FILE PAGES 269-274, INCLUSIVE, ALL OF THE DARE COUNTY PUBLIC REGISTR
